name: Anaerobic membrane bioreactor (AnMBR)
applications: high-COD industrial effluent with full solids retention
principle: Combines anaerobic treatment with membrane solids retention: an anaerobic reactor (CSTR or UASB-style) paired with submerged or sidestream UF/MF membranes holds all biomass and solids, enabling long SRT at short HRT, biogas capture from dilute feeds and a solids-free effluent; licensor equipment follows Kubota/ADI published configurations (submerged flat-plate or hollow-fibre modules under gas scour).

process_steps.name: Membrane solids retention
equipment: submerged UF/MF modules with gas scour

process_steps.name: Permeate polishing
equipment: nutrient or sulphide polishing as needed

performance.basis: published AnMBR performance on industrial effluent

gaps.item: capital cost per m3/d of installed capacity, with dollar year
gaps.reason: Total treatment cost (0.35-0.42 EUR/m3) is now recorded. Capital cost per m3/d was not present in any source loaded on 2026-11-16; the gap is narrowed to that.
gaps.action: Leave open until a source states this metric; do not derive it from an unrelated scope.

gaps.reason: The IEA guide covers anaerobic digestion but not municipal wastewater process units; no agency TRL exists for most of them. Checked 2026-11-16.

costs.basis: CAPEX plus OPEX minus electricity revenue, 100-1,100 mg COD/L influent. Not a capital cost per m3/d, which is what the gap asks for.
